name: Pedalcycle With Electric Assist
description: A single category, not the three-class system: a pedalcycle of 100 pounds or less with operable pedals and an electric motor rated at no more than 750 watts that can't propel it past 20 mph on its own, legally a bicycle.

restrictions.rule: Weighs no more than 100 pounds, with two or three wheels more than 11 inches in diameter (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §102, as amended by Act 154 of 2014)
Operable pedals and an electric motor rated at no more than 750 watts (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §102)
The motor alone can't propel it faster than 20 mph on a level surface; a throttle is allowed (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §102)
No class system: Pennsylvania has not adopted the three-class model law
Riders must be 16 or older (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §3514)
Riders and passengers under 12 must wear a bicycle helmet, including a child in a bike seat or towed trailer (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §3510)
Carries only as many riders as it's designed for, though an adult may carry a child in an attached child seat or trailer (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §3504)
No driver's license, title, registration or insurance
Follows the same rules of the road as a bicycle; banned from freeways (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §§3501, 3511)
May be ridden on sidewalks, yielding to pedestrians, except in a business district unless signs allow it or where a bike lane runs alongside (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §3508)

In state parks and forests, allowed on roads and on trails open to bicycles, but must be pedaled, not run on throttle alone, on non-motorized trails; barred from natural areas and yellow- or orange-blazed hiking trails
A parent may not knowingly let their child break these rules; a violation is a summary offense with a $10 fine (Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §§3502, 3503)
One with pedals and an automatic transmission that exceeds these limits but has a top design speed of 25 mph or less is a motorized pedalcycle, a motor vehicle that needs a Class C driver's license
